TC_R01.title: Elemental Heart
TC_R01.flavor: The best travel companion makes every elemental flourish count twice.
TC_R02.title: Journey Compass
TC_R02.description: Use up to [blue]4[/blue] combos per turn. After your [blue]3rd[/blue] combo reward each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
TC_R02.flavor: Every journey starts with the next step.
TC_R03.title: Unbound Compass
TC_R03.description: Replaces Journey Compass. Use up to [blue]4[/blue] combos per turn; your [blue]3rd[/blue] combo grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. Draw [blue]1[/blue] extra card per combo reward.
TC_R03.flavor: Every resonance points the way onward.
TC_R04.title: Traveler Medicine Chest
TC_R04.description: The first time each turn you Exhaust a Status or Curse, gain 5 Block.
TC_R06.title: Expedition Drum
TC_R06.description: After your 2nd combo reward each turn, your next manually played single-target Attack this turn deals double base damage on its first hit.
TC_R07.title: Statue Blessing
TC_R07.description: The first time you trigger an elemental combo each combat, gain 6 Plating.
TC_R05.title: Tricolor Prism
TC_R05.description: If your first card each turn has no element, give it random Wind, Stone or Lightning for this combat.
TC_R08.title: Wall-Piercing Nail
TC_R08.description: Your first Stone-Lightning follow-up hit each turn applies 1 Vulnerable to its target.
TC_R08.flavor: Walls are thinner than they look. So is the outermost one.
TC_R09.title: Echo Spool
TC_R09.description: Your first Wind-Stone combo reward each turn applies 1 Weak to a random enemy.
TC_R09.flavor: Tie it securely. Last time, only a shadow returned.
TC_R10.title: Reverse Watch
TC_R10.description: With either compass, you can use up to 5 combos per turn.
TC_R10.flavor: You have another chance. It says that every time.
TC_R11.title: Outside Letter
TC_R11.description: Lose 2 HP at combat start. Receive all three combo rewards to heal 5 HP, once per combat.
TC_R12.title: Address Correction
TC_R12.description: On turn 1 of each combat, draw 1 fewer card and add a random unupgraded elemental Traveler reward card to hand with Ethereal, free this turn.
TC_R13.title: Unclaimed Mail
TC_R13.description: Normal combat card rewards offer 1 extra choice. Taking a card costs 15 Gold; skipping grants 10 Gold.
TC_R13.flavor: Every returned letter bears your name.
TC_R14.title: Outside Letter
TC_R15.title: Address Correction
TC_R14.description: Lose 2 HP at combat start. Heal 5 HP at the end of turn 3.
TC_R15.description: On turn 1 of each combat, draw 1 fewer card and add a random unupgraded non-Rare reward card for your character to hand with Ethereal, free this turn. Excludes X-cost and Unplayable cards.
